Our compensation to revenue ratio for the year ending December 31, 2026 is currently estimated to range from 26% to 28% (unchanged from our guidance provided last quarter) and takes into consideration the Atlantic House acquisition, planned hires as well as year-end compensation adjustments and the annualization of hires made during 2025.

We currently estimate our discretionary spending for the year ending December 31, 2026 to range from $83.0 million to $87.0 million (as compared to the guidance range of $83.0 million to $89.0 million provided last quarter).
For the year ending December 31, 2026, we currently estimate that our gross margin percentage will be 83% to 84% (unchanged from our guidance provided last quarter).

We currently estimate third-party distribution expense to be approximately $21.0 million to $23.0 million for the year ending December 31, 2026 (as compared to the guidance range of $20.0 million to $24.0 million provided last quarter).

We currently estimate our interest expense for the year ending December 31, 2026 to be $54.0 million (unchanged from our guidance provided last quarter) taking into consideration our current capital structure.

This estimated rate may change and is dependent upon our actual taxable income earned in relation to our forecasts as well as any other items which may arise that are not currently forecasted.
